subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a session-owned multi-turn model lease contract for `/model --turns N`, and should that contract also shape the related one-turn override API?
rationale: The request adds public CLI/API/config and persistent model-routing semantics; source inspection can show the gap, but automation should not choose turn counting, warning timing, auth-profile preservation, fallback interaction, and overlap with one-turn overrides.

options.title: Specify A Unified Lease Contract
options.body: Define a maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway shape against that single contract.

options.title: Defer To One-Turn API First
options.body: Keep this issue open but settle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 before designing multi-turn leases.

options.title: Reject Native Leases
options.body: Document manual `/model default`, channel model defaults, or external operational policy as the supported cost-governance path instead of adding native turn leases.

recommendation.title: Specify A Unified Lease Contract
recommendation.body: Define a maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway shape against that single contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed feature-history signal across per-session model selection, `/model`, and Gateway session patch paths.
